Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
I am the vine; you are the branches. If you remain in me and I in you, you will bear much fruit; apart from me you can do nothing.
The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed, which a man took and planted in his field. Though it is the smallest of all seeds, yet when it grows, it is the largest of garden plants.

For everyone who asks receives; the one who seeks finds; and to the one who knocks, the door will be opened.

Truly I tell you, if you have faith and do not doubt, not only can you do what was done to the fig tree, but also you can say to this mountain, Go, throw yourself into the sea, and it will be done.

Do not be afraid of those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul.
Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.
So do not worry, saying, What shall we eat? or What shall we drink? or What shall we wear? For the pagans run after all these things, and your heavenly Father knows that you need them.
I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will never go hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.
If you remain in me and my words remain in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.

The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to proclaim good news to the poor. He has sent me to proclaim freedom for the prisoners and recovery of sight for the blind, to set the oppressed free.
Very truly I tell you, whoever believes in me will do the works I have been doing, and they will do even greater things than these.
The kingdom of heaven is like treasure hidden in a field. When a man found it, he hid it again, and then in his joy went and sold all he had and bought that field.

You are the light of the world. A town built on a hill cannot be hidden.
Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things. Come and share your master's happiness!
Do not let your hearts be troubled. You believe in God; believe also in me.
Blessed are those who are persecuted because of righteousness, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

It is I; don't be afraid.
Blessed are you when people insult you, persecute you and falsely say all kinds of evil against you because of me. Rejoice and be glad, because great is your reward in heaven.
Your Father knows what you need before you ask him.
I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.

Daughter, your faith has healed you. Go in peace and be freed from your suffering.
If you can? Everything is possible for one who believes.

Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.
This brother of yours was dead and is alive again; he was lost and is found.
The angel said to them, Do not be afraid. I bring you good news that will cause great joy for all the people.
For God did not send his Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through him.
Even the very hairs of your head are all numbered. So don't be afraid; you are worth more than many sparrows.
I have told you these things, so that in me you may have peace.
The prayer offered in faith will make the sick person well; the Lord will raise them up.
Weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.
For nothing will be impossible with God.
When you give a banquet, invite the poor, the crippled, the lame, the blind, and you will be blessed. Although they cannot repay you, you will be repaid at the resurrection.
Be on your guard; stand firm in the faith; be courageous; be strong.
I am the resurrection and the life. The one who believes in me will live, even though they die.
The Lord will fight for you; you need only to be still.
When you pass through the waters, I will be with you; and when you pass through the rivers, they will not sweep over you.
Delight yourself in the Lord, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
I can do all this through him who gives me strength.
Suppose one of you wants to build a tower. Won't you first sit down and estimate the cost to see if you have enough money to complete it?
Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the Lord your God will be with you wherever you go.
I will bless those who bless you, and whoever curses you I will curse; and all peoples on earth will be blessed through you.
Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways submit to him, and he will make your paths straight.
The Lord himself goes before you and will be with you; he will never leave you nor forsake you. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged.
Call to me and I will answer you and tell you great and unsearchable things you do not know.
The Lord is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.
Be strong and take heart, all you who hope in the Lord.
What good is it for someone to gain the whole world, yet forfeit their soul?
So do not fear, for I am with you; do not be dismayed, for I am your God.
The Lord bless you and keep you; the Lord make his face shine on you and be gracious to you.
He gives strength to the weary and increases the power of the weak.
God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
Before they call I will answer; while they are still speaking I will hear.
Those who sow with tears will reap with songs of joy.
But those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles.
If anyone has ears to hear, let them hear. Consider carefully what you hear. With the measure you use, it will be measured to you.
The Lord is with me; I will not be afraid. What can mere mortals do to me?
Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights.
And my God will meet all your needs according to the riches of his glory in Christ Jesus.
For I am convinced that neither death nor life, neither angels nor demons, can separate us from the love of God.
The Lord has heard my cry for mercy; the Lord accepts my prayer.
He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
For we are God's handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance for us to do.
A good tree cannot bear bad fruit, and a bad tree cannot bear good fruit. By their fruit you will recognize them.
When I am afraid, I put my trust in you. In God I trust and am not afraid.
I know the plans I have for you, declares the Lord, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.
Be still, and know that I am God.
Where can I go from your Spirit? Where can I flee from your presence? If I go up to the heavens, you are there.
If my people, who are called by my name, will humble themselves and pray, I will hear from heaven, and I will forgive their sin and will heal their land.
The joy of the Lord is your strength.
No weapon forged against you will prevail, and you will refute every tongue that accuses you.
Not everyone who says to me, Lord, Lord, will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only the one who does the will of my Father who is in heaven.
God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power and of love and of a sound mind.
And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him.
Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.
I will be a Father to you, and you will be my sons and daughters, says the Lord Almighty.
The eyes of the Lord are on the righteous and his ears are attentive to their prayer.
Surely goodness and love will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the Lord forever.
Be joyful in hope, patient in affliction, faithful in prayer.
Whoever finds their life will lose it, and whoever loses their life for my sake will find it.
The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in him, and he helps me.
See what great love the Father has lavished on us, that we should be called children of God!
And the peace of God, which transcends all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.
Never will I leave you; never will I forsake you.
Draw near to God and he will draw near to you.
The Lord your God is with you, the Mighty Warrior who saves. He will take great delight in you; in his love he will quiet you with his singing.
For I am the Lord your God who takes hold of your right hand and says to you, Do not fear; I will help you.
Every kingdom divided against itself will be ruined, and every city or household divided against itself will not stand.
Even though I walk through the darkest valley, I will fear no evil, for you are with me; your rod and your staff, they comfort me.
How great is the love the Father has lavished on us! Behold what manner of love is this, that we should be called children of God.
The Lord is my shepherd, I lack nothing. He leads me beside quiet waters, he refreshes my soul.
Behold, I am making all things new. I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. To the thirsty I will give water without cost from the spring of the water of life.

The Lord is near. Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God. And the peace of God will guard your hearts and minds.
